page.overview:
Who is Karl Haulzemoff?

"Karl has one job: to take Victor H. wherever he wants to go. A luxury transporter for the rich and the villainous, Karl keeps his privacy glass up and his eyes on the road and he doesn't ask too many questions. Sure, he misses the simpler days of moving legitimate business cars to and from garages, but hauling the main crime boss is just too lucrative for him to even think about getting out now."

In the film, he is first seen as hauling around Victor Hugo. Karl was later seen in a tent when Mater got captured and put in him.

In Kinect Rush: A Disney/Pixar Adventure, he is seen with Zündapp and his Professor Z's Helicopter and later when Professor Zündapp is defeated, he and the Helicopter are defeated too but his defeat is unknown.
